title: Are You Judging the Work, or Its Maker?
summary: A translation of the same day's philosophy episode, debating whether a work can be separated from the person who made it; it sets Plato's polite expulsion of the poet from the ideal city — on the grounds that the imitator does not know what he imitates — against Wimsatt and Beardsley's intentional fallacy, Barthes's death of the author and Foucault's question what
